verdict.rationale: Docs describe Replit Agent generating full-stack apps from a prompt/description, including UI (design/frame-to-website flows, visual layout tweaking) and backend logic (auto-provisioned auth, database, hosting, integrations) all from a single conversation/prompt. This directly matches the frontend+backend from one prompt story, corroborated by a community example of a user building an app via Replit Agent. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of frontend+backend generation quality/reliability, and no benchmark comparing generated UI vs backend fidelity.
